shigong-archive-theme.note: Drop foundry.css into a real module folder and reference it from `styles`. The selectors target Foundry v13/v14 ApplicationV2 chrome plus the legacy .window-app fallback. Tint Foundry's bundled Font Awesome icons via --color-warm-1 rather than replacing the icon font. Use 어둠 inside journals/items to render the [bracket] signature in monospace.
